Hi Soojin / Ben —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Ridgeway Cloud is excited about Redwood’s latency/cost profile for our inference-heavy indexing pipeline. We discussed pursuing ACE registration so we can engage AWS co-sell (PDM/PSM) and potentially include Redwood in our marketplace listing.

Can you share the ACE registration checklist and the evidence AWS typically asks for (SOC2, data flow diagram, deployment regions, estimated monthly spend)? We’d also like to get a PDM/PSM intro on the calendar to review co-sell expectations and any marketplace prerequisites.

Target timeline on our side: finalized paperwork + ACE registration by end of May so we can align Q3 GTM.

Attaching a brief one-pager on our use case in this thread for context (see later message with network diagram).

Thanks,

Caroline — great to meet last week and appreciate the summary. I’ve attached our ACE registration checklist (ace-registration-checklist.pdf) to this reply — it lists the common evidence items and typical turnaround times. High-level asks from AWS/PDMs are usually:

- SOC 2 report or attestation date
- Network diagram + data residency details
- Expected monthly spend and core use-cases (tokens/embedding units)
- Contact for procurement and compliance

Proposed next step: quick intro meeting to run the PDM/PSM through the opportunity and agree on the mutual action plan. Ben — can you help coordinate and pull a short MAP with milestones (registration, co-sell sync, marketplace listing window)?

Caroline — what are 2–3 times next week that work for a 30-minute intro? We’ll try to align with AWS PDM availability.

Best,
